attempts.sql: SELECT package AS folder_path, SUM(line_count) AS total_lines FROM auto_ontology_code.code.files WHERE package != '' GROUP BY package HAVING SUM(line_count) > 1000 ORDER BY total_lines DESC;

request:
Within auto_ontology/server/, which immediate subfolders contain more than 1,000 lines of Python in total? Count every .py file anywhere inside the subfolder, including its test files and __init__.py; files directly in auto_ontology/server/ itself belong to no subfolder. Return the subfolder's repository-relative path (e.g. auto_ontology/server/chat) and its total line count.

Requested output columns: folder_path (string), total_lines (integer).
Return exactly the requested output columns, using each requested name as the column alias, in the requested order. Return complete repository-relative file paths and complete symbol IDs exactly as stored. When the question asks which files, symbols or modules, return each distinct one once unless it asks for occurrences.
explanation: This query counts total Python lines per immediate subfolder (package) under auto_ontology/server, excluding files directly in the server directory (empty package). It sums line_count from all .py files including __init__.py and test files, groups by package, and filters to only those subfolders exceeding 1,000 total lines. Results are ordered by total_lines descending.
sql: SELECT package AS folder_path, SUM(line_count) AS total_lines FROM auto_ontology_code.code.files WHERE package != '' GROUP BY package HAVING SUM(line_count) > 1000 ORDER BY total_lines DESC;
